# Corpus

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Corpus`](gmeow-Corpus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Corpus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

An indexed collection of source information objects over which retrieval operates — the working document set behind a pipeline, distinct from the documents slice's bibliographic [`gmeow:Collection`](gmeow-Collection.md) (a [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md)). Members via [`gmeow:corpusMember`](../properties/gmeow-corpusMember.md); content-addressable via the EXISTING [`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md), so an index can prove WHAT it indexed.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Corpus`](gmeow-Corpus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
